resources.string: Check whether an app allows internal audio capture. Only the selected app is captured. The last 10 seconds stay in memory; nothing is saved. Audio is sent only when you choose Capture and send to Pixel. No microphone sound is recorded.
Experimental: checks whether capture continues with media volume at zero. The previous volume is restored on Stop if it is still zero.
Currently silent. Play content in the selected app. A growing duration alone does not prove audio was captured.
Android ended capture. Check whether this happened when locking the screen.
The selected app is not installed.
Internal audio capture active · last 10 seconds in memory

1. Keep AirPods connected to Pixel. Do not connect Xiaomi audio to AirPods.

2. Select an app, tap Start and approve Android capture. If offered, choose the entire screen. No video is recorded.

3. Switch to that app and play 15 seconds of content. Return here, Stop, then Play. Listen on this device’s normal media output.

4. Repeat with the mute switch enabled. Captured playback should still be audible after Stop restores volume.

5. Repeat while Wahoo is foreground, then separately lock and unlock the screen. Note whether capture stops.

Repeat for YouTube, VLC and Pocket Casts. Stop and Clear when finished. Each Start replaces the previous sample.

Pixel receives audio over Wi-Fi and plays it through its connected AirPods. Xiaomi captures and sends the selected app. Use trusted Wi-Fi or Pixel’s hotspot: this prototype sends unencrypted mono audio locally.
Wi-Fi audio receiver active · Bluetooth output required
No Wi-Fi gateway found. Enter the address shown on Pixel.
Local network permission is required. Grant it in app settings to continue.

1. Keep AirPods audio connected to Pixel. Start Bluetooth HR sharing in main EveryPods on Pixel if testing HR too.

2. On Xiaomi, force-stop main EveryPods to prevent automatic audio handover. Leave Wahoo available. Do not connect AirPods audio to Xiaomi.

3. Connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi, or turn on Pixel’s hotspot and join it from Xiaomi.

4. On Pixel, open this probe and tap Receive on Pixel. Approve local-network permission. Note its address and code.

5. On Xiaomi, select the source app above, enter Pixel’s address and code, and tap Capture and send to Pixel. On Pixel’s hotspot, the gateway button fills Pixel’s address. Approve Android capture; choose entire screen if offered.

6. Play content in the selected app. Enable the mute switch here on Xiaomi if you want to silence its speaker. Pixel should play the stream through AirPods. Check Wahoo on Xiaomi still receives fresh HR.

Stop capture on Xiaomi and Stop receiver on Pixel when finished. Network loss, capture revocation and Bluetooth route loss stop the current stream; restart manually. The receiver may remain waiting after sender disconnects.
